newsitem.title: UK: EMI signs exclusive deal with Sting.
newsitem.headline: EMI signs exclusive deal with Sting.

text.p: British music company EMI Plc said on Thursday it had signed an exclusive worldwide publishing deal with rock star Sting, including his entire back catalogue.
The deal will also cover Sting's current work and future musical output.

Sting shot to fame in the 1970s as the lead singer of pop group "The Police", with the chart-topping single "Message in a Bottle." After going solo he has had a string of hits including the album Synchronicity.
EMI said in a statement Sting's worldwide appeal meant the deal was a major opportunity for the company.
